text: Two armed men on a red motorcycle stopped me at gunpoint and took my mobile phone and wallet.
Someone picked my pocket on the crowded bus near Saddar and stole my cash.
My business partner took 15 lac rupees investment from me and issued a bank cheque that bounced due to insufficient balance.
A stranger sold me a fake iPhone after claiming it was original and blocked my number afterwards.
A group of five armed dacoits broke into our house at midnight, held the family hostage and looted jewellery.
The landlord sent armed goons who broke into my rented shop, damaged furniture and threatened to kill me if I did not vacate.
An unknown caller continuously calls my sister, using filthy language and threatening to defame her family.
A reckless driver shot at a security guard after an altercation at the parking lot with intent to kill.
A rival family attacked my brother with iron rods causing serious fractures on his arm and shoulder.
The corrupt accountant embezzled company funds that were entrusted to him for employee salaries.
Police caught a suspect selling stolen laptops and motorbikes in the illegal grey market.
A local criminal syndicate sent a threatening letter demanding 5 lakh rupees extortion bhatta from our shop.
My neighbour blocked the public passage with concrete bricks preventing our vehicles from passing through.
A former employee posted edited private photos and malicious lies on social media to destroy my reputation.
Armed kidnappers took a 10-year-old child outside his school into a black car.
Do larkon ne bike pe aakar pistol dikhai aur mera mobile aur wallet cheen kar bhaag gaye.
Mera dost mujhse udhaar paise le kar cheque de gaya jo bank me bounce ho gaya.
Bazaar me kisi ne meri pocket se 20 hazar rupaye nikal liye.
Ek shakhs ne mujhe qatal karne ki dhamki di phone par.
Ghar me chor ghus gaye aur almari se sona chura kar le gaye.
